[SWS_TcpIp_00167] ⌈The TcpIp shall support the Fully Qualified Domain Name Op-
tion for Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 Client requirements as defined in
IETF RFC 4704 (The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6) Client
Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) Option). No DNS shall be supported. Only sec-
tion 4 DHCPv6 Client FQDN Option and section 5 DHCPv6 Client Behavior shall be
supported. Sub-Section 5.1, 5.2, 5.4 shall not be supported.⌋()
